senses.gloss: रुश् RUŚ, Ⅵ. P. ruśa, only pr. pt. f. ruśánti, cropping, browsing on (AV.¹).
रुष् ruṣ, f. (nm. ruṭ) anger, wrath, rage: 🞄-ā, f. id. (gnly. —˚ a.): -anvita, pp. filled with 🞄anger.

रुशत् rúś-at, pr. pt. (-ī) bright, brilliant 🞄(night), shining, white (V.);
 disagreeable, 🞄displeasing, harsh (speech): (d) -vatsa, a. 🞄having white calves (RV.¹).
